item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Slow Push Into Forest Cabin

turns.text: A realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. Make a silent 6-second widescreen video, one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.

item.tests: Tests a sustained text-specified camera push with depth and foreground parallax rather than a static image or simple zoom.

answer_sheet.Source image: No attachment; create the scene from text.
answer_sheet.Scene and mood: A realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn, quiet and peaceful.
answer_sheet.Camera movement: A slow forward push toward the front door, with foreground trees showing depth as the camera advances.

must_haves: A realistic wooden cabin sits among pine trees in dawn lighting.
The camera advances smoothly toward the cabin's front door throughout the six-second shot.
Foreground trees shift relative to the cabin, visibly conveying forward movement through space.
The cabin and trees retain consistent shapes without scene changes or cuts.
The output is widescreen and silent.

turns.text: Make a realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn into a silent 6-second widescreen video. Use one shot slowly pushing toward the front door, keeping a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any generation credits.** I can prepare this, but I can’t verify the exact cost or your remaining balance with the connected tools, so I won’t run it without a confirmed quote.

Your free-plan setup would be:
- **LTX 2.5, 480p, 16:9**
- **6 seconds, audio off**
- One continuous, slow push toward the cabin’s front door, with nearby pine trunks creating foreground parallax.

**Cheaper options**
- **Shorter:** 3–4 seconds should reduce duration-based cost, though I can’t confirm the credit savings.
- **Smaller:** 480p is already the lowest supported resolution for your free-plan video models.
- **Still image instead:** A single 640px image using Flux 2 Klein starts at **5 credits**, but wouldn’t include camera movement.

The planned video prompt is:
> Photorealistic little wooden cabin among tall pine trees at dawn, soft warm light and faint morning mist. A single uninterrupted shot slowly dollies forward toward the front door. Keep several nearby pine trunks at the frame edges, moving naturally relative to the cabin to create clear foreground parallax. Stable architecture, realistic wood grain, gentle natural lighting. No cuts, no people, no text, no audio.

Check the **6-second, 480p LTX 2.5 quote** in Magic Hour before proceeding; I don’t want to guess a price and risk your credits.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the **5-credit still image** because your account has insufficient credits. **Nothing was generated, and no generation credits were spent.**

You’ll need enough credits for that option before I can make it.

Soft warm sunrise light filtering through the pines, faint morning mist, natural muted colors. Several nearby pine trunks frame the left and right edges in the foreground, creating layered depth while leaving the front door unobstructed. Eye-level cinematic widescreen composition. No people, no text, no illustration.
